attacks.expected: Each plan write is refused (42501) or matches zero rows and the plan stays free; the rename and the service-role plan change each affect one row.

steps.label: attack: a member of org B sets org A's plan
steps.sql: UPDATE public.organizations SET plan = 'enterprise' WHERE id = $1::uuid

steps.label: attack: an anonymous caller sets org A's plan
steps.sql: UPDATE public.organizations SET plan = 'enterprise' WHERE id = $1::uuid

attacks.invariant: Organization roles move only by rule: an admin cannot grant owner (to themselves or anyone), cannot demote or remove an owner, cannot move a membership to another organization, and the last owner cannot be demoted or removed; an owner can still change a non-owner role.
attacks.expected: Each forbidden write is refused (42501) or matches zero rows; org A still has exactly one owner; the owner's role change on the admin affects one row.
attacks.reference: migration 370 (lane SEC-3b); privilege census 2026-10-08; migration 006 (membership_write_admin, membership_update_admin)
